ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface area displays a contrast distribution of approximately 35% high-intensity (white) pixels to 65% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the distal-lateral quadrants of both lobes; the central longitudinal axis is a solid low-intensity black region; a high-frequency mottled transition zone exists at the interface; three distinct dark circular focal spots are located in the distal-mid region of the left lobe white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels, creating a sawtooth-like contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a distinct concave mathematical curve from the central region extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated dark circular pixel clusters on the left white ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the lower-left white region of the ventral fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the lobe tips; parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe; numerous irregular notches of varying sizes along the trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle loading creates a bulbous, irregular texture at the distal extremities, disrupting the linear geometry of the lobe tips.
